A village where only twins get born

Imagine walking into a village and seeing TWO versions of almost everyone! 👀

This isn’t a cloning factory. It’s Kodinhi, a village in Kerala, India, famous for its unusually high number of twins. Research has reported around 45 twin births for every 1,000 births here, roughly five times India’s national average. Scientists have looked into genetics, the environment and even the water, but nobody has found a definitive explanation.

And imagine being a teacher here. You call one name and TWO students turn around! 😂
